life.title: EMERGENCY: CREW IN DANGER
life.text: A SERIOUS FAULT THREATENS THE CREW. FLIGHT CONTROL MUST DECIDE HOW TO RESPOND.

mission.title: PROBLEM: MISSION AT RISK
mission.text: A FAULT ENDANGERS THE MISSION OBJECTIVE. FLIGHT CONTROL MUST DECIDE HOW TO RESPOND.

alarm.title: WARNING: GO / NO-GO
alarm.text: A WARNING LIGHT SHOWS ON THE CONSOLE. THE READINGS ARE BORDERLINE. FLIGHT CONTROL MUST DECIDE: GO OR ABORT.

scenarios.title: WARNING: HEAT SHIELD MAY BE LOOSE
scenarios.text: TELEMETRY INDICATES THE HEAT SHIELD LANDING BAG MAY HAVE DEPLOYED EARLY, AS ON MERCURY-ATLAS 6. KEEPING THE RETRO PACKAGE ON MAY HOLD THE SHIELD IN PLACE. GO OR ABORT?

scenarios.title: PROGRAM ALARM 1201
scenarios.text: THE GUIDANCE COMPUTER IS OVERLOADED DURING THE LUNAR DESCENT, AS ON APOLLO 11. THE LANDING MAY CONTINUE ON THE REMAINING TASKS. GO OR ABORT?

scenarios.title: WARNING: LAUNCH READINGS
scenarios.text: ENGINE PRESSURE READINGS ARE NEAR THE LIMITS DURING ASCENT. GO OR ABORT?

scenarios.title: WARNING: DOCKING READINGS
scenarios.text: THRUSTER READINGS ARE ERRATIC DURING THE DOCKING APPROACH. GO OR ABORT?

scenarios.title: THRUSTER STUCK, CAPSULE SPINNING
scenarios.text: A STUCK ATTITUDE THRUSTER SPINS THE DOCKED SPACECRAFT, AS ON GEMINI 8. THE CREW RISKS BLACKING OUT. ABORT, OR WORK THE PROBLEM?

scenarios.title: THRUSTER STUCK, CAPSULE SPINNING
scenarios.text: A STUCK ATTITUDE THRUSTER SPINS THE CAPSULE, AS ON GEMINI 8. THE CREW RISKS BLACKING OUT. ABORT, OR WORK THE PROBLEM?

scenarios.title: EXPLOSION IN SERVICE MODULE
scenarios.text: AN OXYGEN TANK RUPTURES IN THE SERVICE MODULE, AS ON APOLLO 13. POWER AND AIR ARE FAILING. SWING AROUND THE MOON FOR A SAFE RETURN?
